name: Inverite Insights Inc.
summary: Headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, Inverite Insights Inc. was founded in 2015, operating previously as Marble Financial Inc. until its renaming in January 2024. The company specializes in artificial intelligence-powered software that processes real-time financial data, enabling business lenders and other financial institutions to enhance data, verify identities (KYC), manage risks comprehensively, and ensure regulatory adherence. Inverite runs its own cloud-based platform, offering transactional capabilities and a Risk Model as a Service (RMaaS). Furthermore, it supplies sophisticated open banking and consumer-focused financial solutions, including banking verification tools crucial for income assessment, informed credit decisions, fraud mitigation, and compliance with know-your-client (KYC) and anti-money laundering (AML) regulations within the financial sector.
